title: DataSource
description: A configured connection to an external data system used by the Xceptor platform for ingesting or exporting data.

id.description: The unique identifier of the data source

name.description: The display name of the data source

type.description: The type of data source connection

status.description: The current connection status of the data source

created_at.description: The date and time the data source was configured

updated_at.description: The date and time the data source was last updated

last_used_at.description: The date and time the data source was last used
